learning_outcomes.text: After completing the module "Thermofluid Dynamics", students will know fundamental hydrostatic, thermo- and fluid dynamic laws and will be able to apply the general laws of energy conversion. They can analyze energy-specific material properties and select suitable tools. They understand thermo- and fluid dynamic laws and can apply them to technical processes.

After completing the module, students are able to transfer hydrostatic, thermo- and fluid dynamic laws to practical applications. This applies in particular to fundamental processes in energy conversions.
After completing the module, students can prepare, present and discuss results of selected analyses, measurements and calculations.

Students can perform calculations on the thermodynamic behavior of fluids in apparatuses based on idealized assumptions. They understand the different boundary conditions for analyzing technical processes in energy conversion and can identify suitable procedures and evaluate appropriate applications with regard to technical challenges.

syllabus_topics: Properties of fluids and concept of continuum, ideal gas law
Steady flow processes and pipe flows
The first and second laws of thermodynamics
Changes of state and equations of state
assessment_rules: The graded examination is a written exam (Klausur) as specified in the current study regulations. The ungraded examination is an experimental work consisting of 2-3 experiments. Both are required for ECTS credit.
